name: BDE-153
source: Li et al. Environ. Sci. Technol. (2020) 54,  166–175; Li et al. ACS Environ. Au (2022) 2, 376–395

mustInput.pKaAcid: Acid dissociation pKa; 9999 is the placeholder for not applicable to a non-ionizable chemical.
mustInput.pKaBase: Base dissociation pKa; 9999 is the placeholder for not applicable to a non-ionizable chemical.
mustInput.KawNeutral: Air–water partition coefficient for the neutral species (dimensionless).
mustInput.KoaNeutral: Octanol–air partition coefficient for the neutral species (dimensionless).
mustInput.KowNeutral: Octanol–water partition coefficient for the neutral species (dimensionless).
mustInput.KawIon: Air–water partition coefficient for the ionic species (dimensionless). Zero for a non-ionizable chemical.
mustInput.KoaIon: Octanol–air partition coefficient for the ionic species (dimensionless). Zero for a non-ionizable chemical.
mustInput.KowIon: Octanol–water partition coefficient for the ionic species (dimensionless). Zero for a non-ionizable chemical.
mustInput.deltaUawJPerMol: Internal-energy change for air–water partitioning used in temperature adjustment (J/mol).
mustInput.deltaUowJPerMol: Internal-energy change for octanol–water partitioning used in temperature adjustment (J/mol).
mustInput.deltaUoaJPerMol: Internal-energy change for octanol–air partitioning used in temperature adjustment (J/mol).
mustInput.kAirCm3PerMoleculeS: Reaction rate constant with gas-phase OH radicals (cm³/molecule/s).
mustInput.kAquaticPerHour: First-order whole-body biotransformation rate constant for aquatic organisms, normalized to 10-g bodyweight (h⁻¹).
mustInput.kMammalianPerHour: First-order whole-body biotransformation rate constant for mammals, normalized to 70-kg bodyweight (h⁻¹).
mustInput.kHumanMetabolismPerHour: First-order whole-body human biotransformation rate constant, normalized to 70-kg bodyweight (h⁻¹).
mustInput.activationAirJPerMol: Activation energy for temperature dependence of reaction with gas-phase OH radicals (J/mol).
mustInput.activationBiodegJPerMol: Activation energy for temperature dependence of biodegradation (J/mol).
mustInput.activationBiotaJPerMol: Activation energy for temperature dependence of biotransformation in aquatic organisms and mammals (J/mol).
mustInput.activationMetabolismJPerMol: Activation energy for temperature dependence of human biotransformation (J/mol).

environmentalAndBiologicalOptional.KcationExchangeLPerMol: Cation-exchange capacity used for ionic sorption (L/mol_CEC).
environmentalAndBiologicalOptional.fractionUnbound: Dimensionless fraction unbound to plasma protein and thus remaining freely dissolved (0–1).
environmentalAndBiologicalOptional.kSurfacePerHour: First-order degradation rate constant for artificial surfaces indoors or outdoors (h⁻¹).
environmentalAndBiologicalOptional.kInvertebratePerHour: First-order whole-body biotransformation rate constant for invertebrates, normalized to 10-g bodyweight (h⁻¹).
environmentalAndBiologicalOptional.kAvianPerHour: First-order whole-body biotransformation rate constant for birds, normalized to 1-kg bodyweight (h⁻¹).
environmentalAndBiologicalOptional.activationSurfaceJPerMol: Activation energy for temperature dependence of surface degradation (J/mol).
environmentalAndBiologicalOptional.PappCaco2CmPerS: Apparent permeability in the Caco-2 intestinal cell assay (cm/s).
environmentalAndBiologicalOptional.renalSecretionMultiplier: Scaling factor that adjusts glomerular filtration to account for additional contributions of tubular secretion and other unaccounted mechanisms; 1 represents the unscaled model value.
